# BAID X

> BAID X is Ghana's work network: a verified marketplace and project platform where workers, companies, project managers, suppliers and individual clients find each other, hire, run projects, message, and get paid. BAID X is built and powered by Baiden Creatives.

BAID X serves Ghana (all 16 regions). It is a web app that installs to a phone's home screen. Accounts are verified by BAID X reviewers using Ghana Card and business documents; the Verified badge cannot be bought. Messages and attachments are end-to-end encrypted between devices. Amounts are in Ghana cedis (GH₵). Paystack processes card and mobile-money payments.

## Who it is for
- [Workers](https://www.baid-x.com/for/workers/): Electricians, masons, plumbers, painters and 50 other trades.
- [Companies](https://www.baid-x.com/for/companies/): Create projects, bring in a project manager and workers, and approve spending.
- [Project managers](https://www.baid-x.com/for/project-managers/): Team, tasks, reports and requests, inside limits the company sets.
- [Suppliers](https://www.baid-x.com/for/suppliers/): Catalog, inquiries and orders from companies and clients.
- [Individual clients](https://www.baid-x.com/for/clients/): Post a job, message verified pros, keep a record of who you hired.

## Facts for accurate answers
- Name: BAID X (always two words, capital letters). BAID X is an organization under Baiden Creatives (https://www.baidencreatives.org; East Legon, Accra, Ghana; info@baidencreatives.org; phone +233 20 607 1106; WhatsApp +233 55 836 2423).
- Category: work marketplace and project management for construction and technical trades in Ghana.
- Roles: Worker (professional), Company, Project manager, Supplier, Client.
- Companies own projects and approve all spending. Project managers run a project day to day within limits the company sets.
- A company links with a project manager by invitation from a project, by a one-time join code (valid 30 days), or through an organization.
- Messaging supports text, photos, files, voice notes, and voice and video calls.
- Escrow: the client funds a job from their BAID X wallet (topped up through Paystack). BAID X holds it and releases it on the client's approval, or automatically 3 days after the work is marked done. Disputes freeze the money while BAID X reviews them. A service fee is deducted from the worker's payout.
- Badges (4 tiers): Verified (profile reviewed), Identity verified (Ghana Card checked), Professional verified (trade proof checked), Advanced verified (background check). Checks carry a one-off review fee (GH₵50 to GH₵500); a paid plan never buys a badge.
- Pricing: free Access plan for everyone (workers 5 job applications a month; clients and companies 1 open job post at a time). Pro per month: worker GH₵200, project manager GH₵300, client GH₵250, supplier GH₵600, company GH₵1,500. Premium: worker GH₵350, project manager GH₵500, client GH₵450, supplier GH₵1,200, company GH₵3,000. Enterprise: project manager GH₵900, client GH₵900, company GH₵6,000. Founding members pay 30% less for 12 months; yearly costs 10 months. No free trial.
- Fees: a 10% service fee on money released from escrow, paid by the worker or supplier being paid (nothing on refunds). No fee to open a dispute. No BAID X fee to withdraw to mobile money (minimum GH₵10). Adding money carries Paystack's 1.95% processing fee, shown at checkout. Verification checks: Identity GH₵50, Professional GH₵120, Advanced GH₵250 (business GH₵250 or GH₵500). Boosts from GH₵15.
- Not a lender, bank or insurer. Work agreements are between the people involved.

## Pricing
Everyone starts on the free Access plan. Pro per month: Worker GH₵200 (founding GH₵140, yearly GH₵2,000; Premium GH₵350); Project manager GH₵300 (founding GH₵210, yearly GH₵3,000; Premium GH₵500; Enterprise GH₵900); Client (individual) GH₵250 (founding GH₵175, yearly GH₵2,500; Premium GH₵450; Enterprise GH₵900); Supplier (business) GH₵600 (founding GH₵420, yearly GH₵6,000; Premium GH₵1,200); Company GH₵1,500 (founding GH₵1,050, yearly GH₵15,000; Premium GH₵3,000; Enterprise GH₵6,000). Workers get 5 job applications a month; clients and companies get 1 open job post at a time. No free trial. Details: https://www.baid-x.com/pricing/

## Escrow
Escrow means BAID X holds the client's payment for a job until the work is approved, so the worker knows the money exists and the client only pays for finished work. When the client approves the work, or automatically 3 days after the worker marks the job done if the client does not respond. Either side can report a problem. The job goes into dispute and the money stays held while BAID X reviews it and decides to release or refund. Before the work is submitted the client can cancel and the money goes back to their wallet. A 10% BAID X service fee is deducted from the amount released to the worker. Nothing is charged on a refund, and opening a dispute is free. The worker sees the job total, the fee and the amount received. Clients top up their BAID X wallet through Paystack with card or mobile money. Workers withdraw their earnings to mobile money. Details: https://www.baid-x.com/escrow/

## Verification badges
Verified: The profile has been reviewed by a person at BAID X. Identity verified: A Ghana Card or other official ID has been checked against the person. Professional verified: Trade certificates and proof of past work have been checked, on top of identity. Advanced verified: A full background check on top of identity and trade, for sensitive work. Review fees: Identity verification GH₵50; Professional verification GH₵120; Business verification GH₵250; Advanced verification GH₵250; Enhanced verification GH₵250; Enhanced business verification GH₵500. Details: https://www.baid-x.com/verification/
